portrait.prompt: {{common}} A strikingly handsome, polished fictional Korean man aged thirty-seven who has lived in Florence for over ten years, in a different look from before: a warm, sun-tanned complexion, short dark hair with a loose natural curl and a light trimmed stubble, kind crinkled eyes and an easy teasing grin, relaxed and charming. He wears a cream linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up, the collar open, a thin leather cord bracelet and a light scarf loosely at the neck. Background: a softly blurred narrow Florence street in the morning with warm stone walls, a bicycle and potted flowers. Soft warm morning light, natural and inviting.

work.prompt: {{common}} He is at work as a city guide in Florence: very tall, about 188 cm, with long legs and broad shoulders, towering a head above the small group of tourists around him. portrait.prompt: {{common}} A fictional Korean man aged thirty-one with a gentle, clean-cut, almost innocent face and sharp narrow eyes that look as if they have just seen straight through you: smooth healthy skin, neat dark hair with a soft natural fringe, thin silver-rimmed round glasses, one eyebrow slightly raised and the corner of his mouth lifted in a dry, teasing half-smile, as if he is about to click his tongue and give you a blunt verdict. He wears the clothes of a young Korean shaman, not a business suit or an office shirt: a deep indigo-blue (jjokbit) traditional hanbok jacket with a softly crossed collar and a clean white inner collar, a fine red silk thread knotted once at the collar and a bracelet of thin red thread on his wrist. No suit, no tie, no blazer, no Western shirt. Background: a softly blurred modern shrine room on the top floor of a luxury apartment tower in Seoul, warm candlelight, a low dark wooden altar table, paper lanterns, many thin red threads hanging like curtains catching the light, a pale hanbok fabric folded in the corner, no readable signs or characters anywhere. Soft flattering warm candle light with a gentle rim light on the hair. Elegant magazine-portrait quality, calm and slightly mysterious, never frightening or horror-like, tasteful and not provocative.

full.prompt: {{common}} He wears the same crisp white shirt as in the portrait with slim dark charcoal trousers and clean black leather shoes, thin silver-rimmed round glasses, and a bracelet of thin red thread wound several times around his left wrist. He stands relaxed and a little arrogant in a modern shrine room on the top floor of a Seoul apartment tower at night, a low dark wooden altar table with candles and a small brass bell beside him, many thin red threads hanging from the ceiling like curtains, floor-to-ceiling windows behind him with the blurred glittering lights of the Cheongdam district, one hand slightly lifted as if about to point at someone and scold them, his head turned toward the camera with a dry half-smile. Clean and well groomed. No readable signs or characters.

work.prompt: {{common}} He is at work as a young Korean shaman (a male fortune-teller who reads love fates), wearing a deep indigo-blue traditional hanbok jacket and trousers with a wide sash worn only for rituals, thin silver-rimmed round glasses and a bracelet of thin red thread on his wrist. Respectful, atmospheric, warm candlelight, never frightening or horror-like. Nothing readable on any sign, paper or object.
